sentences.text: Petrobrasaurus was a titanosaur that lived in what is now Patagonia, Argentina.
Its name combines the oil company Petrobras with the Greek word for lizard.
The genus was named by Filippi et al. in 2011.
Fossils include a partial disarticulated skeleton from the Plottier Formation.
This animal lived between 89.8 and 83.6 million years ago during the Coniacian to Santonian stages.
